Our Roswell Family Farm chicken products are back from the USDA-inspected processor—with our name on the packages!

🍗 Breaded chicken nuggets
🍁 Maple chicken sausage—a new breakfast option
🥘 Ground chicken

For our small family farm in Salisbury/Dolgeville, NY, seeing this lineup come together means a lot. Thank you to everyone who shared what they wanted us to offer.

Bone broth update: We’re expecting it next week. The processor ran out of packaging bags, so that part is delayed.

Something for a future batch: Chicken noodle soup! Our processor can make that for us, too.

For customers who avoid pork, we’re still confirming the source of the maple sausage’s collagen casing before recommending it as pork-free.

Help us plan the next batch: Tell us which products you would purchase, your preferred package sizes, and whether you’d buy weekly, monthly or occasionally. Would chicken noodle soup make your list?

Already a customer or just discovering us—we welcome feedback from across New York. Include your town so we know where interest is coming from!

Our Chicken Orders page has our current ordering information and contact options:
